mechanism: A decade of life in a low 5-8 channel was broken by one violent upward displacement to the 44.01 life-peak in May 2026, already 60% given back; a secondary pulse (Aug 13-17, 16.8 to 19.93) carried the month's only channel death on its ignition day and is now being handed back two sessions running. On the final day upward gates fire in four of five readings while price slides lower each reading - displacement effort absorbed without result, the stored tension of the spike still draining toward the old channel. The lattice itself stays intact (S_UF 0.935, no dead channels), so this is orderly distribution of a spent pulse, not structural collapse.
